design.aux_head: LayerNorm(1024) -> Linear(1024,256) -> SiLU -> Linear(256,1); zero-init last layer; input = mean-pooled action-expert post_dit tokens (feat_dim 1024)
design.target: normalized max fingertip pad force at the last action step (t+AH) over ACTIVE channels only (left pads ch12/13; right pads masked out)
design.dropout: T7_FORCE_DROPOUT=0.1 zeroes the 8-step force history and its mask per sample
design.checkpoint: force_head saved with every checkpoint; optimizer state includes it (572 entries); resume loads it and falls back gracefully on old checkpoints
design.eval: aux head is training-only; eval unchanged except force_stats (contact_frac, strong_contact_frac, contact/release force medians, force_max)

bug_found_and_fixed.symptom: at step 1 loss_force was exactly 0 and the zero-init head received zero gradient; step-1 last layer stayed 0.0
bug_found_and_fixed.cause: force target took max over all 4 pad channels; right pads are always 0, so no-contact frames (left channels negative after normalization) were forced to 0
bug_found_and_fixed.fix: take max over active channels only (factive > 0)
bug_found_and_fixed.post_fix: fresh smoke at step 500-502: loss_force 0.8799, last layer absmax 1.996e-4 (nonzero) after 2 steps

ckpt_pre.note: step1 vs step11 head diff 8.4e-6: the head was connected but the zero-target bug kept most batches flat; fixed afterwards
